snippet.title: Noirmancer Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Noirmancer is an in development supernatural stealth game in which you use powers like the ability to turn to mist, shrink tiny, and erase memories to infiltrate businesses and investigate the secrets they're hiding.

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3674590/Noirmancer/

Try out the Alpha Demo and share your thoughts: https://distractedmosfet.itch.io/noirmancer-alpha-demo

Special thanks to Giovanni Fim (https://www.artstation.com/ggtfim) for making the promo art you see in the thumbnail, and WungusDasPungus (https://linktr.ee/wungusdaspungus) for making this trailer. Contact them to work on your promo art and trailer needs :)
